definitions.explanation: A person who has the right to vote in elections. In Japan, all citizens aged 18 and older have the right to vote.

examples.japanese: {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}の{投票率|とうひょうりつ}が{低|ひく}い。
{候補者|こうほしゃ}は{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}に{支持|しじ}を{訴|うった}えた。
examples.english: The candidate appealed for support from voters.

examples.japanese: この{選挙区|せんきょく}の{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}は{約|やく}10{万人|まんにん}いる。
examples.english: There are approximately 100,000 eligible voters in this electoral district.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, news-oriented term used in political and electoral contexts. The voting age in Japan was lowered from 20 to 18 in 2016.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}{数|すう}: number of eligible voters
- {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}の{意識|いしき}: voter awareness
- {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}の{声|こえ}: the voice of voters
